answer: The cheapest real defence: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because echo only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, lagoon is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any dawn approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
